Overview of Galicia Region (Galicia)

Galicia Region (Galicia) is located in the Galicia region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Santiago de Compostela. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Santiago de Compostela Cathedral & Old Town, Rías Baixas & Cíes Islands, A Coruña Tower of Hercules, Lugo Roman Walls & Ribeira Sacra canyon.

RegionGalicia
Capital citySantiago de Compostela
Cities & municipalities45
Primary transport hubSantiago de Compostela Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Galicia Region

AVE high-speed rail from Madrid to Ourense and Santiago de Compostela (~3h15); Santiago (SCQ), Vigo & A Coruña airports. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Galicia

When visiting cities across Galicia, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Pulpo a la gallega (Polbo á feira)
  • Percebes, Zamburiñas & Galician seafood
  • Empanada Gallega
  • Tarta de Santiago
  • Albariño (Rías Baixas) wine

Best time to visit Galicia

Best time to visit Galicia: May–Oct.
